name: Theorie-examen vrachtwagen C en vakbekwaamheid

english.name: Belgium Truck Licence Theory Test (C/CE and CPC)
english.fullName: Belgium truck licence C/CE theory exam and driver CPC (vakbekwaamheid, code 95), in Dutch

notes: 4 tests x 50 = 200, every item in exactly one test (pools exactly 4x each count). A test is one 50-question half of the real combined proef A: about half licence theory (verkeer 8, rijbewijs 4, techniek 6, remmen 6 = 24) and half vakbekwaamheid (rijtijden 7, tachograaf 5, lading 6, veiligheid 5, milieu 3 = 26); the split is Tigertest's, GOCA publishes no weights. passPct 80 = 40 of 50, the real per-half exemption line and the 80/100 pass rate of the combined proef (C alone is 41 of 50). Five topic sets 25801-25805 (48/48/48/24/32) + 4 tests = 9 dashboard steps.
